analysis.title: USA: GS Economic Indicators Update
key_insights: The nominal GS US Financial Conditions Index tightened by 9.2bp to 98.92 over the last week, mostly due to lower equity prices. The real GS US FCI tightened by 9.8bp to 98.58.
GS Q4 GDP forecast is +1.8% quarter-over-quarter annualized.
The GS US MAP index of economic surprises increased on net to +0.4.
The preliminary October GS Current Activity Indicator is +3.3%, up from +3.0% in September.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Tighter financial conditions, driven mostly by lower equity prices.
Inflation-adjusted conditions tightened slightly more than the nominal index.
Economic data surprised slightly to the upside on net.
Activity growth picked up from +3.0% in September.
